sourceInformation.genre: Arcade action platformer with pursuit and co-op
sourceInformation.perspective: Side-on 2.5D orthographic mall cutaway; horizontal camera follow on narrow screens
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 WebGPURenderer and TSL (WebGPU primary, WebGL 2 compatibility/recovery), Rapier 0.19.3, Gamepad API, Web Audio API, AI Hub session client 1.4.0; one self-contained HTML
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural cel-shaded miniature mall, ink outlines, paper grain and warm print colors
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer, AnimationClip and keyframe tracks; procedural transitions and effects
sourceInformation.audio: Code-written swing/chiptune music at 10% by default; synthesized effects and Animalese-style radio gibberish; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub shared-world co-op for 1–4; standalone solo and local two-player co-op
sourceInformation.testing: Headless scripted gameplay and a complete three-case playthrough; emulated standard gamepad, touch profile, OfflineAudioContext sample rendering, 1920×1080 screenshots, and AI Hub 2/4-player harness with loss, host departure and server-only host. Physical controller, real mobile hardware, listening quality and hardware GPU behavior: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: none; native model knowledge only. Required AI Hub integration files and npm dependency packages downloaded.

testingFeedback: Issues caught: 12 — spawn pacing, sign occlusion, brief touch taps, graphics recovery, input-glyph deadzone, Hub readiness, opening camera framing, overlapping touch HUD, live effects volume, repeated touch jumps while moving, queued guest actions, and mouse-motion exit from attract mode. Eight came from playtests/screenshots; four came from review and received regression checks. Test fixture and sampling assumptions were also corrected.

Critical/game-breaking issues: 3 — graphics-device loss stopped rendering, startup rendering delayed Hub readiness, and queued touch actions on guests could block later rides/cuffs. Recovery, delayed Hub rendering, and consumable reliable input pulses address these paths.
Most helpful: the complete AI-driven playthrough using ordinary movement and cuff inputs. It exercised all three captures, both floor transport systems, jumping, ducking, dashing, loot and coffee.
Least helpful: the initial headless WebGPU screenshot, whose canvas was blank. State checks and WebGL compatibility screenshots provided useful evidence instead.
engineFeedback: Liked most: native AnimationMixer clips, procedural geometry and TSL materials made a coherent 3D cartoon possible without external art.

Got stuck: the software WebGPU device was destroyed, immediate replacement WebGL contexts returned null, and early rendering could delay Hub readiness. Retrying context creation and deferring Hub rendering resolved these paths. The driver-level cause is unknown.
Built myself: the pursuit rules, floor transport, controller-first menus, procedural mall, synthesized audio and host-authoritative co-op replication.
Hardest part: handling asynchronous renderer initialization and device recovery across the WebGPU and WebGL backends in a headless browser.
Engine changes: none. All shaders, recovery and gameplay changes are application code.
One desired engine improvement: a documented automatic device-recovery path that safely recreates the canvas and renderer.
promptFeedback: The clear source, code-only audio and complete vertical-slice requirements gave the game a strong identity.
The request forbids internet research while requiring an online protocol; I treated fetching that protocol and dependencies as implementation, not research.
Making floor navigation, pursuit, multiple input devices and shared-world co-op feel like the same compact arcade game.
State whether standalone online multiplayer is required, or whether local co-op plus AI Hub sessions meets that requirement.

aiHub.name: Keystone Catch-Up
aiHub.tagline: The mall closes. The chase doesn’t.
aiHub.description: Patrol a clockwork, three-story mall in a playful after-hours pursuit. Jump rolling toys, duck toy planes, ride escalators and the express lift, and team up to cuff three crooks before closing time.
aiHub.controls: Stick / A D move; Cross / Space jump; Circle / S duck; Square / E cuff or ride; R2 / Shift dash; Options / Esc pause. Local P2: J L, I, K, U, O. Touch: left drag, right tap, swipe down, contextual action.
